artifacts.rule: per search of tier t (urn 1, sarcophagus 2, chest 3) in room r: divisor = r×2×t×35; gold if divisor÷650 beats the roll, else stone if divisor÷250 does, else common

rules.note: chest and door xp are 66% of the listed open xp; lockpicked doors give half

rules.brotherItemChance: each roll: 1 in (450 − 58 × brothers killed) to award one random remaining item from the killed brothers' sets, otherwise one roll on the regular table; repeated ids merge

rules.costRule: an item needs every listed pizazz-point type at once, and each is spent
rules.wandUpgrades: slots 1-3 (the wand upgrades) consume the previous slot's wand (or require the slot-3 wand)
rules.bonesToPeaches: the Bones to Peaches spell (item 6926) is a one-time unlock

rules.smithingXpPerBarProcessed: 1 per bar smelted, shared by everyone in the area when the furnace temperature is 51-66
rules.steel: iron ore becomes steel when coal is present and Smithing is at least 30
rules.coalNote: the furnace needs half the normal coal per bar

rules.note: ticket prices are not stored in the shop config (price comes from the item's value); winners get 2 tickets, a draw 1 (Lanthus dialogue)

rules.rolls: rolls per player = ceil(fish caught by the ship ÷ players aboard); each caught fish adds 3 to the ship's fish
rules.fishRoll: when the table gives 'fish', every fish you meet the level for is tried best-first with chance (level − 15) × (0.7852 − 0.6133) ÷ 84 + 0.6133; the roll repeats until one succeeds
rules.skipJunk: the reward interface offers an option that drops junk rolls
rules.delivery: loot goes to the bank; Ultimate ironmen, or a full bank, get it in the inventory (fish noted) or on the floor
